interface.description: The network interface to use for wireless scanning.

enable_monitor.description: Whether to automatically enable monitor mode on the interface.

scan_interval.description: The interval in seconds between automatic rescans.

show_hidden.description: Whether to display hidden SSIDs in the results.

show_channel_graph.description: Whether to render the channel utilization graph.

graph_zoom.description: The zoom level for the channel graph, ranging from 0 to 100.

pre_scan_command.description: Shell command to run before starting a scan (e.g., 'iw reg set DE').

post_scan_command.description: Shell command to run after finishing a scan.
